dict.string: Handvel uses the microphone to record and transcribe audio on this Mac.
Handvel needs screen recording access to capture what is on your screen.

Handvel captures system audio through a CoreAudio process tap and transcribes it on this Mac. To leave an app out, add its bundle ID to ~/.screenpipe/audio-exclusions.json.
Handvel needs system extension access to capture audio output.
Handvel adds the action items it finds in your screen and audio activity to Apple Reminders.
Handvel reads your calendar to recognise meetings. Calendar data never leaves this Mac.
